_meta: A key-value store replicated across N nodes. A write is sent to W of the N replicas and a read is answered from R of them (the read returns the newest version among the replicas it contacted). A read is guaranteed to see the latest write only if the read set and the write set are guaranteed to share at least one replica -- and any W-subset and any R-subset of N nodes are guaranteed to intersect exactly when R + W > N (pigeonhole). If R + W <= N, there exist a write set and a read set that do not overlap, so a read can contact only replicas that never received the write and return a stale value. This fixture lists quorum configurations (the write count w and read count r over n replicas) to test; the overlap, the worst case, and a concrete stale-vs-fresh read are all computed by enumerating the actual subsets.
